prompt:
Rewrite snippets/variant-swatch-list.liquid to render a list of variant swatches. Prices are formatted, and discount percentages are computed, using integer arithmetic only. Inputs (all top-level; there is no section object): - `swatches`: array, never null, possibly empty. Every element is an object that always has all four keys: - `name`: string, never null - `price_cents`: integer >= 0 - `compare_at_cents`: integer >= 0, or null - `available`: boolean - `max_visible`: integer (may be zero or negative) or null. Rules: 1. If `swatches` is empty, output the empty string. 2. Otherwise, output `
    ...
`. 3. Visible count: if `max_visible` is null or less than 1, show all swatches. Otherwise, show the first `min(max_visible, number of swatches)` swatches in their original order. 4. Each visible swatch is rendered as `
  • `. If `available` is false, the class attribute is instead `swatch swatch--sold-out`. Inside the li, output in this order: a. `NAME`, where NAME is `name`, HTML-escaped with the `escape` filter. b. `$D.CC`: - D is `price_cents` integer-divided by 100, with no thousands separators. - CC is `price_cents` modulo 100, always written as exactly two digits (left-padded with 0). - Examples: 1205 becomes `$12.05`, 9 becomes `$0.09`, 0 becomes `$0.00`, 123456 becomes `$1234.56`. c. A discount badge `-P%`, output only when all of the following hold: - `compare_at_cents` is not null, - `compare_at_cents` is strictly greater than `price_cents`, and - P > 0. P is `(compare_at_cents - price_cents) * 100 / compare_at_cents`, rounded to the nearest integer. An exact .5 rounds up. For example, 300 off 800 is 37.5, which gives 38; 295 off 1500 is 19.67, which gives 20; 1 off 10000 is 0.01, which gives 0, so no badge is shown. Then close the li with `
    • `. 5. If some swatches are hidden, let N be the number of swatches minus the number of visible swatches. When N > 0, output `
  • +N more
    • ` as the last child of the ul. 6. Do not emit any whitespace or newlines between or around tags; the output must be one contiguous string. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/variant-swatch-list.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
